title: More Materials
description: this mod adds new things to Minecraft
body:
**🧱✨ More Materials Mod**  

More Materials is a Minecraft mod that expands your world with brand-new ores, blocks, tools, weapons,armor sets,biomes,wood sets and fruit

**🧱 New Blocks**  
thunderroot grove wood sets and neonjungle biome wood sets and galaxy biome wood sets and glidwood biome wood sets and glid mud and ores blocks and blocks of all ores

- **🎮 Gameplay Experience**  

More Materials improves Minecraft progression by:  

1. Adding more reasons to mine   
2. Expanding crafting options 
3. Improving combat varieties 
4. add more advancments to minecraft


**🌲 biomes**

thunderroot grove and neonjungle biome and galaxy biome and stonehills and new biome called glidwood i think its my best biome that i ever seen

**🌱 plant**

thunderroot plant and hunt flower and glid bloom and glid grass and tall glid grass


**💎 The Ores**  

- firsta ore in overworld  
  
- amethyst ore in the end  
  
- embar ore in overworld  
  
- peridot ore in overworld  
  
- New section of emerald armor and sword,shovel,axe,pickaxe,hoe
  
- oceanite ore in different types of ocean  
  
- icesta ore  in the overworld  
  
- volite ore in overworld
  
- shadowwite ore in overworld
  
- terrnite ore in overworld

- starfall ore in overworld

- Rootstone ore in overworld

- galaxy ore in galaxy biome

- darkleaf in world surface

- wet ore in stonehill structures

- roselite ore in overworld

- umbrite ore in overworld

- blackish ore in overworld

- neon ore in overworld

**fix bugs (in this update):**

1. fixed the folliage colors of the leaves i mean the leaves that falls from leaves blocks
2. fixed the generation off all biomes that spawn in desert i think....
3. fixed the biome tempertures and humidity


**🌍 Summary**  

More Materials is a complete expansion mod that adds new ores, blocks, tools, weapons, and armor sets to Minecraft It is perfect for players who want more progression, more crafting options, and more adventure in their world.
